competing_explanation: The 30-day window may be outdated, category-specific, or a misreading of a legacy or promotional policy.
hypothesis_statement: H_P: The current return policy for standard items provides a full refund if the item is returned within 30 days of delivery.
refutation_criterion: Current authoritative policy text specifies a different return window, excludes full refunds for standard items, or limits the 30-day full-refund window to non-standard or special items.
